about: The proof that Jellyfin found at another address is the account's own (ServerProof.cs: Mira for Windows and Mac, the extension's /Mira/proof; ServerProof.swift on the iPhone). key = HMAC-SHA256(secret, "mira-proof\n" + the user's id as 32 lowercase digits); proof = base64(HMAC-SHA256(key, nonce + "\n" + the host asked, in lowercase)).
